title: LA passage: Corpus Domini nostri.
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a la passage.

Corpus Domini nostri.

Language: la

anchor.prefix:
purified body.

 —In vitam eternam. Amen.

 Another life! A life of grace and virtue and happiness! It was true. It was not a dream from which he would wake. The past was past.

 —
anchor.suffix: The ciborium had come to him.
